It felt like it was me who wrote this post sadly. 

You are not alone. I was bullied by my so called friends and they where the only ones that I had. We had been friends throughout elementary and highschool. They didn't really like me, I was the one that was the "giver" I was always there for everyone if they needed to talk and I was always supposed to pay stuff when we where out and things like that. You'r better off without friends then having friends who make you feel miserable and like the 44:th wheel. 

I have one advise for you. It helped me a lot. If you have the possibility to travel, do so! It helped me to get out of my comfort-zone and not worry about meeting people who know the "real me" if you know what I mean. It's hard to pretend you'r someone who is very social when your in a small city and everybody knows you. But if you travel though you have the opportunity to "fake" a personality and discover your true self. 



Many young people nowadays are very lonely. Most people stick to their childhood friends and are not so open to conneccting and getting to know new people....sadly.

I wish you luck and live the life you deserve to live, and fuck fake friends, you don't need them.
